text:
maria: pushed changes to PR #4321 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321) — addressed the API contract comments and split the test updates into three small commits. PTAL when you have a sec. Main question: squash into one commit for easier backporting or keep them split for bisectability? I’m leaning split. Also added a short migration note in the changelog.
sam: quick skim — looks good from a surface level. what merge window are we targeting? we have beta deploy tomorrow morning.
leah: if we keep them split, will cherry-picking be harder for backports? any schema/migrations I should worry about?
maria: no schema changes, just a rename and a tiny behavior tweak in the retry logic. tests added and CI passing locally. perf delta is negligible (<1%).
alex: prefer keeping separate commits — easier to reason about if something regresses. can squash when doing a backport if necessary.
ops: FYI if this lands before 12:00 UTC we can include it in tomorrow's beta; after that it'll probably slip to the next cycle.
ci-bot: CI /pr-4321 — all checks passed ✅ (unit, e2e, lint)
sam: ok — i'm +1 on approach but need leah and alex explicit approvals before merging.
maria: tagged @leah @alex PTAL — thanks!
leah: reviewing now, will shout if I see anything. otherwise happy to +1.
alex: tiny nit: commit message for the `fix api-compat` commit should reference issue #987 for traceability. can you update that commit message?
maria: done — amended the commit and force-pushed (git push --force). updated message now includes "refs #987". https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321/files
leah: looks clean to me, adding :+1:
alex: LGTM — approving now.
sam: Approved. Can we schedule the merge at 11:50 UTC so it makes tomorrow's beta cut? :clock11: 
maria: scheduled the merge for 11:50 UTC in the PR description and added the release-note tag. thanks all :tada:
ops: noted — rollback plan is the previous tag (v1.44.2). ping ops if anything goes sideways during roll.
ci-bot: Merge queued at 11:50 UTC by protected-merge-bot.
maria: thanks everyone — closing the loop.
